title: Concept: Hex dependency fetched from a git remote
description: mix.exs declares a dependency sourced from git rather than hex.pm, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The code sits outside hex.pm's checksum and retirement controls, so the lockfile's integrity model does not describe it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through mix.exs (hex).
risk: The code sits outside hex.pm's checksum and retirement controls, so the lockfile's integrity model does not describe it.
